breaking_news.headline: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers

breaking_news.headline: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well

breaking_news.headline: How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls

breaking_news.headline: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
breaking_news.summary: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

breaking_news.headline: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
